methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Maier et al. adaptation)
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: This phone would be super useful for my studies and daily tasks. With its powerful AI and fast processor, I could manage my assignments and reminders easily. The AI personal assistant would definitely help with managing my schedule and staying on top of my classes.
construct_responses.EE: Learning to use this phone might be a bit tricky since it's a different OS, but with the advanced AI assistant, I should be able to figure it out quickly. My current tech comfort level is decent, so I wouldn't find it too difficult to adapt.
construct_responses.HM: Using this phone for gaming, social media, and entertainment would be a lot of fun. The advanced camera and AMOLED display would make my videos and photos look amazing. It's definitely a step up from my current phone, and I'd love to have all these features.
construct_responses.SI: My friends and family would probably be excited to see such a high-end phone. They might even envy me, but they'd also be curious about the price. I think they'd support my choice as long as I stay within my budget.
construct_responses.PP: I feel quite confident about the privacy and security features. The on-device AI processing would help keep my data safe, and the smart battery optimization would be a relief. I'd be happy to have those features, but I'd need to make sure the price isn't too steep.
construct_responses.BI: While I love the features and performance, the price is a bit out of my league. I might consider it if there's a good discount, but for now, it's probably not going to happen. I'd rather stick to my current phone and save up for something more affordable.
construct_responses.OVERALL: Overall, it's an impressive phone with a lot of useful features, but the price is a bit high for me. I'd love to have it, but I need to find a way to save up first.
